title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
Social Media & Content Manager

Read everything carefully before apply.

**At Golden Circle**

We’re looking for someone who is smart, creative, organised, and knows how to get things done.

Someone who can come up with ideas, turn them into content, coordinate with clients, guide creatives, manage projects, and make sure things actually get delivered.

**You don't need an impressive CV. You need an impressive brain.**

We don't really care how many years of experience you have. If you're someone who understands content, thinks creatively, takes ownership, and learns fast, we'd love to meet you.

What will you be doing?

* **Managing social media:**
  Handle social media accounts, plan content calendars, manage posting schedules, and keep things consistent.
* **Thinking creatively:**
  Come up with content ideas, campaigns, reels, posts, and concepts that people actually want to see.
* **Giving creative direction:**
  Brief designers, video editors, and other creatives. Know what you want, explain it clearly, and help turn ideas into great output.
* **Coordinating with clients:**
  Understand client requirements, communicate updates, collect feedback, and keep everyone on the same page.
* **Managing projects:**
  Track deadlines, follow up with the team, handle multiple projects, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.
* **Keeping up with trends:**
  Know what's happening on social media, what's worth trying, and what's just another trend nobody needs to follow.
* **Taking ownership:**
  Don't wait for someone to tell you every little thing. Think ahead, solve problems, and make things happen.

What we're looking for

* Someone smart, curious, and naturally creative.
* Someone who understands Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and how content works.
* Someone who can think beyond likes and followers.
* Someone who can communicate clearly and manage people without creating chaos.
* Someone who can handle pressure, multiple deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.
* Someone who is willing to experiment, learn, make mistakes, and improve.

You don't have to know everything already. But you should be willing to figure things out.

A little reality check 👀

This isn't a job where you schedule a few posts, scroll Instagram, and call it a day.

Some days will be creative. Some will involve client calls, feedback, deadlines, and a lot of follow-ups. You'll need to switch between big-picture thinking and small details without losing your mind.

We expect you to take your work seriously, bring ideas to the table, and own your responsibilities.

**In return?**
You'll get creative freedom, real responsibility, exposure to different industries and brands, opportunities to learn new skills, and a chance to grow with the business. Secret words : I am the one.

Good ideas will be heard. Initiative will be appreciated. And if you're good at what you do, your growth won't be limited to your job title.

Who should apply?

A fresher with exceptional creative thinking? Apply.

Someone who's been freelancing and wants to do more? Apply.

Someone who understands content but doesn't have a fancy degree? Apply.

Someone who's tired of doing repetitive work and wants to take ownership? Definitely apply.

We care more about how you think, how you work, and what you're capable of becoming than what your CV says.

Think you're the right fit?

Don't send us a CV full of buzzwords and generic statements.

Tell us a little about yourself, show us how you think, and share something creative you've done — or an idea you'd love to execute.

Let's see if we can build something great together.

📍
**Location:**
Bopal, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

💼
**Position:**
Full-time

💰
**Salary:**
Based on skills, potential, and fit

📩
**Apply at:**
ag@goldencircleindia.com

**Golden Circle — Good ideas deserve great execution.**

description:

**Profile Summary**
We are looking for a Channel Lead to own the end-to-end execution of marketing across every online and offline channel — the execution engine of the Enterprise Marketing Operating System. The role orchestrates content, creative and digital into seamless campaigns, owns national and regional events, and acts as the primary liaison across Marketing, Sales, Service, Product and regional teams. It ensures the plan is deployed on time, on brand and on budget — and that every channel, from the shop floor to the boardroom, is activated and measured.
  
  
**Work You'll Do**
**Channel Execution & Campaign Orchestration**

* Own end-to-end execution of marketing activities across online and offline channels.
* Coordinate Content, Creative and Digital teams to plan, execute and follow through on campaigns.
* Maintain the channel calendar and ensure consistent, on-time deployment of content, creatives, collateral and promotional materials across regions.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Own logistics and execution of national and regional trade fairs (PlastIndia, PlastiVision, IPLAS, PlexConnect, PackPlus), customer and partner meets, webinars, association conferences, plant visits and regional marketing initiatives.
* Manage booth design and build, merchandise, on-ground staffing and vendor management (fabricators, signage, photo/video, travel).
* Run pre- and post-event demand campaigns, on-site lead capture and structured follow-up with Sales.

**Full-Spectrum Reach**

* Activate the full funnel — CXO roundtables and thought-leadership seminars (top), technical webinars and demo days (middle), and mobile webinars, WhatsApp / SMS and vernacular content (base).
* Run plant-visit programs and all on-site events (open houses, machine handovers, demos) as part of full-spectrum reach.

**Cross-Functional Liaison & GTM Coordination**

* Act as the primary liaison between Marketing, Sales, Service, Product and regional teams.
* Travel to and manage all events is mandatory for this role; coordinate associates' travel, lodging and boarding during events with regional office coordinators and support staff.
* Align campaign timing to the go-to-market calendar and product launches; ensure Sales handoff and follow-through.

**Vendor & Agency Management**

* Manage agencies and vendors at peak load; brief, schedule and quality-check deliverables against the plan.
* Negotiate and track vendor performance, timelines and costs.

**Budget, Logistics & Compliance**

* Track channel-wise spend and activation efficiency; flag reallocation opportunities.

**Team**

The role is the connective tissue between strategy and on-ground results.

* Working knowledge of digital channels, martech and lead-capture / CRM handoff.

title: Senior Analyst Marketing & Communications
description:
Marketing Operations Senior Analyst
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are looking for a Governance & Analytics Lead to own how marketing measures and proves value — the KPI map, the attribution model, data quality, and reporting for the Enterprise Marketing Operating System. This is the independent integrity 'referee' that makes influenced-revenue numbers credible (rules, de-duplication, no self-marking), and the cross-functional insight engine that turns data — including win/loss analysis and competitive intelligence — into decisions for Marketing and for Sales, Product, Service, Engineering, and Leadership.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**
**KPI & Reporting Governance**

* Own the single-source KPI map, definitions, and dashboards across all strategic pillars and their programs.
* Maintain RAG status and exception reviews; publish executive and board reporting packs.
* Build and validate dashboards; guarantee KPI integrity and a single version of the truth.

**Attribution & ROI — the Integrity Referee**

* Own the multi-touch attribution model and credit rules — sourced, influenced, and assist — crediting each pillar exactly once.
* Adjudicate credit against agreed rules with no self-marking; jointly ratify definitions with Finance.
* Report marketing ROI and leverage; measure attribution coverage of marketing-influenced revenue.

**Data Management & Quality**

* Own the complete marketing-department data as the single repository, and make it readily available on-demand to marketing and cross-functional teams.
* Own data hygiene, master-data management, and taxonomy / UTM / tagging governance.
* Ensure data quality across CRM, marketing automation, BI, and the DAM.
* Define and enforce measurement standards for every new program.

**Cross-Functional Analytics & Insight**

* Run win/loss analysis and competitive-intelligence reporting; surface patterns that inform positioning and demand.
* Analyze funnel health, pipeline, velocity, and marketing-influenced revenue.
* Provide decision-ready insight not only to Marketing but to Sales, Product, Service, Engineering, and Leadership.

**Martech, BI & Tooling**

* Administer the BI/analytics stack and marketing-data integrations with IT and Engineering.
* Translate business questions into data models, reports, and self-serve views.
* Support the IT business-requirements and feasibility process for marketing data and systems.

**Planning, Budget & Value Realization**

* Track plan-vs-actual against the AOP / VCP; monitor budget adherence and variance.
* Prepare quarterly business-review analytics; quantify value realization against the long-range plan glide path.

**Enablement & Decision Support**

* Coach the team on metrics literacy and dashboard use.
* Design experiments and measurement for new initiatives; recommend actions from the data.

**Team**
The Governance & Analytics Lead is the measurement and governance backbone of the marketing function, reporting to the Marketing Head and partnering closely with Finance, Sales, Product, Service, Engineering and IT, and with the Channel Lead and Communications Specialist.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years in business analytics, marketing operations, BI, or revenue operations, ideally in B2B / industrial contexts.
* Hands-on with BI tools (Power BI / Tableau / Looker), SQL, CRM / SFDC, and marketing automation.
* Proven experience with attribution modeling, funnel and pipeline analytics, and KPI / dashboard governance.
* Strong data-hygiene, taxonomy, and tagging-governance discipline; comfort with data-quality and MDM practices.
* Financial fluency — able to partner with Finance on ROI, budget adherence, and value realization.
* Excellent stakeholder management and data storytelling; able to make numbers credible and decisions obvious.
* High integrity and independence — comfortable acting as the neutral 'referee' on credit and reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's / MBA is preferred.

**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.

title: Manager / Sr. Executive – Affiliate & Brand Alliances (Beauty / D2C)
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

title: Deputy General Manager Marketing Cardio
description:
Head of Marketing – Cardiology Division

**Department:**
Sales & Marketing

**Designation:**
Head of Marketing / Deputy General Manager – Marketing

**Division:**
Cardiology

**Industry:**
Pharmaceutical

**Location:**
Corporate Office

**Reporting To:**
Business Unit Head / Business Head

1. Job Purpose

To lead the strategic marketing function for the Cardiology Division by developing and executing marketing strategies, driving brand growth, strengthening market share, and achieving revenue and profitability objectives. The role involves managing the cardiac product portfolio, developing innovative brand strategies, enabling the field force, and building strong engagement with cardiologists and other healthcare professionals in compliance with applicable pharmaceutical marketing regulations.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Strategic Marketing & Business Planning**

* Develop the annual marketing strategy, business plan, and brand-wise growth objectives for the Cardiology Division.
* Drive revenue growth, market share expansion, product penetration, and profitability.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, prescription trends, and emerging therapeutic opportunities.
* Identify growth opportunities across acute and chronic cardiovascular therapies.
* Develop short-term and long-term business strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

**B. Brand Management & Product Strategy**

* Lead the development and implementation of brand plans for cardiovascular products.
* Manage the product portfolio covering hypertension, dyslipidemia, ischemic heart disease, heart failure, antiplatelet therapy, and other relevant cardiac therapies.
* Develop product positioning, scientific communication, promotional campaigns, and differentiated brand strategies.
* Identify opportunities for new product launches, line extensions, and portfolio expansion.
* Monitor brand performance and implement corrective actions to achieve business targets.
* Ensure marketing materials are scientifically accurate, appropriately substantiated, and compliant with company policies and applicable regulations.

**C. Market Research & Competitive Intelligence**

* Conduct market analysis using relevant pharmaceutical market data, including IQVIA or other industry-standard sources.
* Track competitor launches, pricing strategies, promotional activities, and market share movements.
* Identify unmet medical needs, prescribing patterns, and emerging therapeutic trends.
* Translate market intelligence into actionable marketing and sales strategies.

**D. Sales Force Effectiveness & Field Force Support**

* Collaborate with the Sales Head and regional teams to achieve division-level business objectives.
* Develop effective promotional inputs, product presentations, visual aids, and scientific detailing materials.
* Conduct product training, brand workshops, and capability-building programs for field personnel.
* Establish measurable marketing KPIs and monitor campaign effectiveness.
* Support field implementation through cycle meetings, joint fieldwork, and periodic performance reviews.

**E. Key Opinion Leader (KOL) & Healthcare Professional Engagement**

* Develop professional engagement strategies for cardiologists, consulting physicians, and relevant healthcare institutions.
* Plan scientific conferences, cardiology forums, continuing medical education programs, and product-related educational initiatives.
* Build appropriate professional relationships with key opinion leaders and scientific experts.
* Ensure all healthcare professional engagements comply with applicable ethical codes and company policies.

**F. New Product Development & Launch Excellence**

* Identify potential products and therapeutic segments for portfolio expansion.
* Work with Business Development, Medical, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain teams to assess product opportunities.
* Prepare launch plans, forecasts, positioning strategies, and promotional readiness plans.
* Monitor new product performance against launch objectives and implement post-launch improvements.

**G. Budgeting, Analytics & Performance Management**

* Prepare and manage the annual marketing budget.
* Monitor brand-wise sales, growth, profitability, market share, and promotional expenditure.
* Evaluate the return on investment of marketing campaigns and scientific initiatives.
* Present periodic business reviews, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management.

**H. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the marketing team, including Product Managers, Group Product Managers, and other marketing professionals.
* Establish performance objectives, review deliverables, and build a culture of accountability and innovation.
* Collaborate with Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Supply Chain, and Business Development teams.
* Ensure timely execution of marketing plans and effective cross-functional coordination.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of division sales and revenue targets.
* Growth in market share and brand performance.
* Achievement of brand-wise growth and profitability targets.
* Successful launch and performance of new products.
* Effectiveness of promotional campaigns and marketing expenditure.
* Quality and timeliness of brand plans and marketing initiatives.
* Improvement in field force productivity and product knowledge.
* Effectiveness of KOL engagement and scientific programs.
* Marketing budget adherence and forecast accuracy.
* Compliance with pharmaceutical marketing and ethical standards.

4. Educational Qualifications

* MBA / PGDM in Marketing from a recognized institution.
* B.Pharm, M.Pharm, or a science-related graduation is preferred.
* A combination of pharmaceutical education and strong commercial marketing expertise will be advantageous.

5. Experience

* **Overall experience:**
  15–20 years in the pharmaceutical industry.
* **Relevant marketing experience:**
  At least 8–10 years in pharmaceutical sales and marketing, preferably in cardiovascular therapy.
* Prior experience as a Marketing Head, Group Product Manager, General Manager – Marketing, or equivalent leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience in managing cardiac brands, launching products, and driving business growth.
* Experience leading and developing a marketing team and working closely with a large field force.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of the cardiology and cardiovascular therapeutic market.
* Strategic thinking and commercial business acumen.
* Expertise in brand management, product lifecycle management, and new product launches.
* Strong analytical skills and familiarity with pharmaceutical market research data.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate market insights into effective business strategies.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
* High standards of integrity and compliance with pharmaceutical marketing regulations.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a strategic pharmaceutical marketing leader with a proven track record of building cardiovascular brands, expanding market share, launching new products, and driving sustainable business growth. The candidate should combine strong therapeutic understanding with commercial acumen, team leadership, and the ability to execute marketing strategies effectively across a pan-India sales network.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
Arvind Advanced Materials (AAML) is the technology-led advanced materials platform of Arvind Limited, part of the Lalbhai Group and one of India's most established textile and materials businesses. We engineer fibre into finished performance for industries where the material decides the outcome: protective fabrics for people who work in hazardous environments, lightweight composites for infrastructure and mobility, and filtration media that help industry run cleaner.

Integrated from fibre to certified finished product, AAML works across three businesses:

* **Human Protection:**
  flame-retardant and protective fabrics and garments for industrial, utility and defence users.
* **Composites:**
  pultruded profiles, prepregs and composite pressure vessels for infrastructure, energy and mobility.
* **Industrials:**
  filtration media, belting and coated fabrics for demanding industrial processes.

With manufacturing in India, the United States and Egypt, and customers in more than 50 countries, AAML is investing in new technologies, global partnerships and international growth. Building a modern, brand- and demand-led marketing function is central to that next chapter.

About the role

We are building AAML’s marketing function and seeking a hands-on B2B marketer to strengthen our digital presence and create clear, compelling content and sales collateral. As the first dedicated marketing hire, you will work closely with the Chief Strategy & Marketing Officer, corporate communications, business and technical teams, and external agencies engaged for specialist support. This is a chance to shape how an ambitious, technology-led materials business presents itself to customers in India and around the world.

Your primary focus will be digital strategy, content and collateral. You will personally develop messaging and write and edit core content, while briefing and managing specialist design, website and video production. The role also includes marketing support for 2–3 exhibitions annually.

Key responsibilities

Digital strategy and execution

* Develop a prioritised digital marketing plan aligned with business goals, target customers and available budgets. Recommend the right mix of website content, SEO, LinkedIn, email and paid campaigns.
* Manage the content calendar and day-to-day digital activity; work with agencies on website improvements and specialist campaign execution.
* Track engagement, enquiries and lead sources; use findings to improve content, channel choices and spend.

Content and sales collateral

* Work with sales and technical teams to understand products, applications and customer needs, translating these into clear, credible messages and customer benefits.
* Write and edit website copy, brochures, pitch decks, case studies, sample-book content, social posts and video scripts. Tailor materials to priority audiences and markets.
* Brief and review design, photography and video work; ensure the business teams validate technical claims before publication.
* Maintain an organised library of current, approved collateral and incorporate feedback from sales teams.

Collaboration and delivery

* Manage agency briefs, timelines, quality and agreed budgets for assigned projects. Coordinate internal inputs and approvals to keep work moving.
* Keep AAML’s messaging and visual identity consistent across all materials, working with the CSMO and corporate communications; contribute content for PR and leadership communications.
* Coordinate marketing for 2–3 exhibitions annually, including event messaging, collateral, pre-event promotion, display and booth briefs, and lead capture. Work with vendors on production and logistics and with sales on post-event follow-up.
* Agree priorities across the three businesses with the CSMO; maintain a simple marketing dashboard; and coordinate lead hand-off with sales and the CRM team.

What you bring

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, with a strong record in B2B marketing and evidence of personal contribution to digital activity and content creation.
* Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn technical information into relevant customer-facing communication.
* Practical digital marketing judgement: selecting channels, planning campaigns, interpreting performance and working effectively with specialists.
* Experience briefing and managing agencies or freelancers, with strong creative judgement and attention to detail.
* Strong project and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working independently and delivering alongside senior leaders, sales and technical teams.
* A portfolio demonstrating your own contribution to B2B content, collateral and digital campaigns.

Preferred

* Experience in technical textiles, materials, manufacturing, chemicals, composites or other B2B product businesses. Strong candidates from other B2B sectors are welcome.
* Exposure to export markets, trade exhibitions, website/CMS management, CRM lead tracking and marketing analytics.
* Practical use of AI tools to support content and campaign workflows, with sound editing and fact-checking; familiarity with presentation and basic design tools.

Education and other requirements

Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for exhibitions, shoots and customer or partner engagements.

What success looks like

Specific priorities and targets will be agreed with the CSMO. As a guide:

* **First 90 days:**
  an audit of current channels and materials, an agreed digital and content plan, a working content calendar, and a first collateral kit for a priority business.
* **First 12 months:**
  refreshed website content delivered with the web agency, a growing library of case studies and application stories, collateral that sales teams use, lead sources tracked from first enquiry, and well-run marketing for the year’s exhibitions.

Creston & Co. helps businesses automate their operations with AI. We build and deploy AI-powered CRM systems, chatbots, and marketing automation that help companies capture more leads, respond faster, and scale without adding manual work.

We work with growing businesses across India and international markets, combining automation, smart workflows, and data-driven marketing to deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll own Creston & Co.’s growth from first click to closed deal: planning and running campaigns that bring in qualified leads, then following up, running discovery calls and demos, and helping convert prospects into paying clients.

**3. Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, and optimise Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, and remarketing).
* Handle keyword research, audience targeting, and conversion tracking.
* Monitor CPC, CTR, CPL, conversion rates, and campaign ROI.
* Optimise ad budgets and landing-page performance.

**4. Social Media Marketing**

* Manage B2B social media, primarily LinkedIn, along with other relevant platforms.
* Create monthly content calendars and coordinate posts, creatives, and campaigns.
* Grow brand awareness, engagement, and website traffic.
* Track performance and recommend improvements.

* Optimise existing website content for search intent and conversions.
* Collaborate with writers and designers on case studies, product pages, and campaigns.

* Build and optimise landing pages and conversion funnels.
* Run email marketing and LinkedIn outreach campaigns.
* Work with CRM and automation platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Apollo.io, or similar.
* Track lead quality, campaign performance, and conversion opportunities.

**7. Sales & Business Development**

* Follow up on inbound leads from campaigns, website, and LinkedIn quickly and consistently.
* Qualify leads by understanding each prospect’s business, current processes, and automation needs.
* Conduct discovery calls and product demos of our AI CRM, chatbot, and automation solutions.
* Prepare proposals and quotations, coordinating pricing with the founder.
* Handle objections and follow up through to closing.
* Run outbound prospecting through LinkedIn, email, and cold outreach to target industries.
* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline in the CRM, with clear deal stages and next steps.
* Share client feedback with the team to improve messaging, offers, and the product.

**8. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor performance across GA4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, and the CRM.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing and sales reports.
* Analyse traffic, leads, conversions, pipeline, and campaign effectiveness.
* Recommend actionable improvements based on data.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, and social media marketing.
* Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Good understanding of B2B lead generation and the sales funnel.
* Experience qualifying leads and running sales calls or demos with business owners.
* Strong negotiation, follow-up, and presentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple marketing and sales activities.
* Strong analytical, communication, and reporting skills.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini for productivity.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience marketing or selling B2B SaaS, CRM, AI, or technology services.

* Understanding of GEO, AEO, and AI-powered search.
* Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM and automation platforms.
* Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar SEO tools.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Job Title:**
Marketing Manager

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Working Days:**
6 days a week

4–7 years

12-15 LPA

**Role Overview**

The Marketing Manager will independently manage the company’s marketing function across online and offline channels. The role involves planning marketing activities, coordinating with internal teams and external vendors, supporting sales and lead-generation initiatives, and ensuring consistent brand communication across all platforms.

As the sole member of the marketing department, the individual will be responsible for independently managing approved marketing initiatives from planning to execution, monitoring their effectiveness, while identifying new opportunities to strengthen brand visibility, generate business enquiries and support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Planning & Execution**

* Develop and maintain an annual and monthly marketing calendar covering all online and offline activities.
* Plan and coordinate ATL and BTL initiatives, including exhibitions, events, promotional campaigns, branding activities and customer engagement programmes.
* Identify and recommend new marketing activities aligned with business objectives, target markets and sales requirements.
* Coordinate the execution of approved initiatives, ensuring timely completion and adherence to approved budgets and achievement of defined campaign objectives.
* Track campaign progress and evaluate completed activities based on reach, enquiries, leads, cost and effectiveness, wherever applicable.

**Vendor & Agency Management**

* Identify and evaluate vendors and agencies for marketing activities proposed by the sales team and approved by the Director.
* Obtain and compare quotations, coordinate negotiations and facilitate vendor finalization as per company policies, ensuring cost-effectiveness.
* Manage external partners for digital marketing, creative development, printing, production, events and other marketing requirements.
* Define and monitor vendor deliverables, timelines and quality standards, and resolve execution-related issues to ensure quality and timely completion.
* Maintain vendor performance records and identify opportunities for cost optimization and service improvement.

**Digital Marketing & Brand Communication**

* Plan and coordinate digital marketing activities across relevant channels, including the company website, social media, search engines and email marketing.
* Coordinate content creation, digital campaigns, lead-generation activities and publication schedules with external agencies and other service providers.
* Ensure consistent brand identity, messaging and visual communication across digital platforms, print materials, events and other customer touchpoints.
* Review marketing content and creatives for accuracy, quality and alignment with approved brand guidelines.
* Track relevant digital marketing metrics, including campaign reach, engagement, enquiries, qualified leads and cost per lead, wherever applicable, and recommend improvements based on campaign performance.
* Coordinate regular updates of website content, product information, company achievements and social media communication.

**Sales Support & Marketing Collaterals**

* Work closely with the sales team to understand market requirements and prioritize marketing support.
* Coordinate the creation and updating of company profiles, product brochures, presentations, catalogues, flyers, banners, case studies and other sales materials.
* Support the planning and execution of sales-driven marketing initiatives, including local promotions, dealer and channel partner meets, exhibitions and customer engagement activities.
* Coordinate marketing material requirements for regional sales teams and field-level promotional activities, ensuring timely availability.
* Maintain a centralized repository of approved marketing materials and ensure that the sales team has access to current versions.
* Coordinate with the sales team to track enquiries and leads generated through marketing activities and assess campaign effectiveness.

**Budgeting, Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Prepare and maintain the marketing activity plan and budget for management approval.
* Coordinate with internal teams to gather requirements, establish priorities and track progress against agreed timelines.
* Maintain records of marketing expenditure, vendor quotations, approvals and campaign deliverables.
* Monitor planned versus actual expenditure and highlight budget deviations.
* Prepare periodic marketing MIS reports covering completed and upcoming activities, expenditure, campaign performance, enquiries, lead generation and vendor performance.
* Evaluate completed activities and vendor performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Present recommendations to management for improving marketing effectiveness and optimising expenditure.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing or Business Administration, or a Bachelor’s degree in Technology followed by an MBA in Marketing. B.Tech + MBA (Marketing) preferred.
* 4–7 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in B2B marketing, integrated marketing or sales enablement.
* Experience coordinating online and offline marketing activities and managing external agencies and vendors.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing channels, marketing collaterals and campaign reporting.
* Experience in solar, renewable energy, electrical equipment, industrial products or related industries will be an added advantage.
* Working knowledge of digital marketing channels, marketing collaterals, campaign reporting and lead-generation metrics.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong planning, coordination and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple marketing activities and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Vendor management, negotiation and budget management capabilities.
* Attention to detail and a strong understanding of brand consistency.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving and identifying marketing opportunities.
* Analytical ability to evaluate campaign performance, marketing expenditure and lead-generation effectiveness.

**Performance Measures**

* Timely execution of the approved marketing calendar.
* Quality and consistency of marketing communication across channels.
* Responsiveness and effectiveness of sales support.
* Adherence to approved budgets and campaign timelines.
* Effectiveness of vendor coordination and digital marketing activities.
* Number and effectiveness of marketing campaigns, events and BTL activities executed.
* Marketing-generated enquiries and qualified leads, wherever applicable.
* Timely submission of marketing MIS and campaign performance reports.

Send your resume to naina@machineastro.com with the subject line "Partner Development Manager – ME & SEA"

title: Trade Marketing Manager
description:
**Job Description – Trade Marketing Manager**

**Role Purpose**

To plan, execute, and evaluate trade marketing initiatives, promotions, visibility programs, and trade loyalty schemes to drive sales growth, improve channel effectiveness, and maximise return on trade marketing investments. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, process orientation, and a sound understanding of sales channels and trade marketing concepts. Drive sales and distribution growth, develop the portfolio, support new product launches, and ensure effective use of trade spends and field assets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Trade Marketing Promotions & Schemes**

Analyse sales data and market requirements to identify trade promotion opportunities and develop an annual/monthly trade marketing calendar.

Design and execute trade schemes, promotions, and loyalty programs for distributors, retailers, and other trade partners.

Ensure accurate communication and timely implementation of trade schemes across the sales network, including field sales teams and PSRs.

Establish tracking mechanisms to monitor scheme performance and evaluate effectiveness.

Conduct pre- and post-scheme analysis to measure ROI, incremental sales, cost-benefit, and overall business impact.

Recommend improvements to enhance scheme effectiveness and drive sustainable growth.

**2. Visibility & Merchandising**

Plan trade visibility initiatives based on channel, market, and business requirements.

Develop visibility guidelines and store layouts to ensure consistent brand presence and merchandising standards.

Coordinate allocation and deployment of visibility materials and monitor timely market execution.

Track visibility effectiveness and recommend corrective actions to improve in-store impact.

**3. Data Analytics & MIS**

Analyse sales, channel, distributor, and scheme performance data to generate actionable business insights.

Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and monitoring mechanisms for trade marketing initiatives.

Identify opportunities for sales automation and reporting improvements in collaboration with the MIS team.

Monitor key performance indicators and share periodic performance reviews with stakeholders.

**4. Budget & Process Management**

Manage the trade marketing budget within approved targets.

Monitor expenditure, scheme costs, and vendor costs to ensure efficient utilisation of resources.

Define and communicate trade marketing processes, policies, and protocols.

Ensure compliance with internal processes, approvals, and budgetary guidelines.

**5. Training & Capability Building**

Develop and deliver train-the-trainer initiatives covering sales call processes, merchandising identification, and trade scheme execution.

Track training effectiveness and recommend corrective actions to improve field execution.

Support sales teams in strengthening their understanding of trade marketing programs and processes.

**6. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

Coordinate with external vendors for trade promotions, visibility materials, and related execution requirements.

Work closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, MIS, HR, and Sales teams to ensure effective implementation of trade marketing initiatives.

Monitor vendor deliverables, timelines, quality, and costs.

Must Have:

* Deliver the primary sales and focus town NSV plans.
* Grow the LOTTE product portfolio through effective distribution, visibility and outlet-level execution.
* Drive distribution and revenue contribution from new product development (NPD).
* Plan and monitor trade schemes to generate volume growth and use allocated spends effectively.
* Track outlet performance against the previous year and take action to improve growth.
* Monitor trade spends, rate differences and DEDC expenses against approved budgets.
* Ensure active field assets are verified and scanned regularly.
* Plan asset scanning with field teams, track completion and close gaps.
* Review sales, distribution, NPD and trade spend performance regularly, and coordinate with relevant teams to address gaps.

**Key Competencies**

**Sales oriented experience:**

* Sales planning and execution
* Distribution and outlet management
* Trade spend planning and monitoring
* NPD launch execution
* Data analysis and performance tracking
* Field team coordination and stakeholder management

Strong understanding of trade marketing concepts and channel dynamics.

Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong commercial acumen, with an understanding of ROI and cost-benefit analysis.

Process-oriented approach with strong planning and execution capabilities.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

**Candidate Profile**

Experience in Sales, Sales Development, Trade Marketing, or Channel Marketing.

Prior involvement in trade scheme planning, promotion design, performance tracking, and ROI analysis.

Experience in sales data analysis, MIS reporting, and Excel-based reporting; exposure to sales automation tools or Power BI is an advantage.

Understanding of distributor and retailer networks, merchandising, and visibility programs.

Exposure to vendor coordination and trade marketing budget management.

Experience in FMCG, food, beverages, or other distribution-led businesses would be preferred.

**Key Success Measures**

Effectiveness and ROI of trade promotions and schemes.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Marketing Manager will design, execute, and optimize marketing strategies that build brand visibility, attract high-quality leads, and support the sales team across key international markets. The candidate should be comfortable operating independently, managing agencies or specialists, using data to make decisions, and aligning marketing activity with sales targets.

Senior marketing roles typically require ownership of demand generation, digital channels, lead qualification, sales enablement, and performance reporting; this position applies those responsibilities specifically to international outsourcing markets.

Marketing Strategy & Planning

* Develop and execute the company’s overall marketing strategy for target markets in the USA, UK, Europe, and Australia.

* Adapt messaging, content, and campaigns to suit the business culture, buying behavior, and communication preferences of each target geography.
* Monitor marketing performance and refine strategy based on lead quality, conversion rates, cost per lead, and pipeline outcomes.

SEO & Website Marketing

* Own the company’s SEO strategy, including keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO coordination, link-building, and local/international SEO.

* Manage website content, landing pages, service pages, case studies, and conversion-focused user journeys.

Inbound Lead Generation

Outbound Lead Generation

Content & Blog Management

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an AI-first software engineering company that helps businesses build intelligent software products, scalable digital platforms, and AI-powered business solutions. We combine AI capabilities with human engineering expertise to help startups, scale-ups, and enterprises accelerate product development, modernize technology, and drive business growth.

Our services include AI-powered product development, AI strategy and consulting, AI development and systems, AI automation, conversational and voice AI, AI integration, cloud infrastructure engineering, data systems engineering, and legacy modernization.

We are building a strong international presence, targeting clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and the UAE.

At Sapiogen AI, SEO is not just about rankings and traffic. It is about building organic visibility, establishing authority in AI and software engineering, attracting decision-makers, and generating qualified business opportunities.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and analytical SEO Executive to strengthen Sapiogen AI's organic search presence and contribute to our inbound marketing strategy.

The ideal candidate should understand technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword research, content optimization, link building, and performance analysis. You will work closely with the marketing team and content writers to improve our website's search visibility, attract relevant international audiences, and generate organic leads.

You should also be interested in the evolving search landscape, including AI-powered search experiences, answer engines, and generative search platforms.

Key Responsibilities1. Keyword Research & Search Strategy

* Conduct keyword research to identify high-intent commercial, transactional, and informational keywords relevant to AI services and software engineering.
* Identify keyword opportunities around AI development, AI consulting, custom software development, AI automation, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Analyze keyword difficulty, search volume, search intent, competition, and business relevance.
* Map primary and secondary keywords to existing website pages and new content opportunities.
* Identify long-tail keywords and service-specific search opportunities targeting international markets.
* Conduct competitor SEO analysis to identify content gaps, backlink opportunities, and ranking strategies.

2. On-Page SEO

* Optimize website pages, service pages, landing pages, blogs, and industry-specific pages.
* Improve title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, image alt text, internal links, and content structure.
* Ensure pages align with search intent and relevant commercial keywords.
* Optimize landing pages for both organic visibility and conversion potential.
* Maintain keyword mapping and prevent keyword cannibalization across website pages.
* Collaborate with content writers to ensure SEO-friendly, readable, authoritative, and user-focused content.

3. Technical SEO

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify website issues affecting crawling, indexing, and rankings.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, broken links, and indexability.
* Identify duplicate content, crawl errors, orphan pages, and internal linking issues.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and overall website performance.
* Implement or coordinate structured data and relevant schema markup.
* Work with developers to resolve technical SEO issues and improve website architecture.
* Verify that important pages are accessible to search engines and render correctly.
* Support SEO requirements during website updates, migrations, and new landing page launches.

4. Content SEO & Topical Authority

* Develop keyword-driven content briefs for blogs, landing pages, service pages, and supporting resources.
* Identify content clusters and topic opportunities that establish Sapiogen AI's authority in AI-first software engineering.
* Optimize existing content to improve rankings, relevance, engagement, and organic conversions.
* Coordinate with content writers to maintain consistent publishing schedules.
* Identify outdated or underperforming content and recommend updates.
* Ensure content demonstrates expertise, provides genuine value, and avoids keyword stuffing or low-quality AI-generated material.
* Support the development of industry pages, use-case pages, comparison pages, and solution-focused content.

5. Off-Page SEO & Link Building

* Identify relevant, authoritative websites for backlink acquisition.
* Execute ethical link-building activities through outreach, guest contributions, digital PR opportunities, and relevant industry partnerships.
* Monitor backlink profiles, referring domains, anchor text, and competitor link-building strategies.
* Identify potentially harmful backlinks and recommend appropriate action where necessary.
* Focus on relevant, quality backlinks rather than spammy link volume.

6. International SEO

* Support organic growth across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and the UAE.
* Research regional keyword variations, search intent, and competitor positioning.
* Optimize service and industry pages for relevant international audiences.
* Identify opportunities to improve geographic relevance without creating unnecessary duplicate pages.
* Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions by country.

7. AI Search, AEO & GEO

* Understand and support emerging SEO practices for AI-powered search experiences.
* Help optimize content for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
* Structure content to answer relevant customer questions clearly and accurately.
* Improve topical authority, entity consistency, structured data, and content credibility.
* Monitor brand visibility and mentions across AI search platforms where reliable measurement methods are available.
* Explore opportunities to improve Sapiogen AI's discoverability across platforms such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity.
* Track changes in organic search and AI-driven discovery without treating unverified AI visibility metrics as guaranteed rankings.

8. Analytics & Reporting

* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and SEO tools.
* Track keyword rankings, organic clicks, impressions, click-through rates, landing page performance, and conversions.
* Prepare weekly progress updates and monthly SEO performance reports.
* Identify traffic drops, ranking changes, indexing issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluate SEO performance based on qualified traffic and business outcomes, not just keyword positions.
* Recommend data-driven actions to improve organic visibility and lead generation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and keyword research.
* Practical experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent SEO platforms.
* Understanding of website architecture, internal linking, indexing, crawling, canonicalization, and redirects.
* Experience optimizing content for search intent, topical relevance, and conversions.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, website performance, and structured data.
* Strong analytical, research, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with developers, content writers, and marketing professionals.
* Understanding of B2B SEO and international SEO will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI search optimization, AEO, GEO, and AI-assisted SEO workflows is desirable.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed targets, baseline website performance, and business priorities.

* Improvement in organic clicks, impressions, and qualified organic traffic.

* Improvement in organic click-through rates and landing page performance.

* Consistent execution of the approved SEO and content optimization roadmap.
* Improvement in organic conversions, enquiries, and marketing-qualified leads.

What We Offer

If you enjoy solving SEO challenges, experimenting with emerging search strategies, and turning organic visibility into meaningful business opportunities, we would like to hear from you.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Company**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies, supporting agencies with consistent and reliable delivery across website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing

Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organisation powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia.

At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly skilled PPC Project Manager who can lead end-to-end performance marketing operations, manage client relationships, and drive measurable growth across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other social platforms. This role requires someone who understands both the technical depth of PPC and the strategic clarity of project management, ensuring every campaign is executed at the highest level.

**Work Location**

* Candidates relocating to Ahmedabad will be required to work from our Ahmedabad office for the first 3 months, after which they can continue working remotely.
* This does not apply to candidates already based in Ahmedabad.

**Responsibilities**

***Campaign Strategy & Execution***

* Plan, launch, and manage high-performance campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and supporting channels.
* Build strategic plans to improve ROI, lower CPA, and scale lead generation and eCommerce revenue.
* Perform deep keyword/audience research, competitor analysis, and funnel strategy planning.
* Create and test new ad copy, creatives, angles, and offers to improve performance.
* Build and optimize retargeting and remarketing funnels, including dynamic ads and multi-step nurturing.

***Client Management & Retention***

* Serve as the primary escalation point for clients—handling concerns, queries, and critical issues with clarity and confidence.
* Lead strategic discussions, performance reviews, and roadmap presentations with clients.
* Focus on client retention through proactive communication, transparency, and result-driven execution.
* Translate client requirements into actionable tasks for the internal delivery team.
* Ensure expectations are aligned and properly documented to avoid scope gaps or misunderstandings.

***Process, SOP, and Quality Management***

* Develop, refine, and maintain internal SOPs, templates, QA checklists, and delivery frameworks.
* Bring structure to campaign setup, reporting, creative requests, optimization cycles, and documentation.
* Improve team workflows and identify gaps in processes, communication, or resource allocation.
* Implement best-practice standards across keywords, ads, tracking, landing pages, and reporting.
* Coordinate with design, content, analytics, and technical teams to ensure predictable delivery quality.

***Performance Monitoring & Reporting***

* Oversee daily, weekly, and monthly performance checks across all PPC accounts.
* Use GA4, platform analytics, and conversion tracking to diagnose issues and identify opportunities.
* Build clean, client-ready dashboards and reports using Looker Studio.
* Conduct landing page, creative, and audience A/B testing to continuously improve performance.

***Team Leadership & White-Label Coordination***

* Lead and support PPC analysts, ensuring tasks are completed with accuracy and consistency.
* Mentor junior team members and conduct reviews to maintain execution standards.
* Work closely with agency partners in a white-label environment, understanding:
* Their client relationships
* Their delivery expectations
* How to communicate strategically under their brand
* Ensure seamless communication between internal teams and white-label partners.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on PPC experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Strong project management & leadership skills: planning, prioritisation, delivery, and documentation.
* Proven experience handling client escalations and turning difficult situations into retention wins.
* Deep understanding of white-label agency dynamics—communication sensitivity, brand alignment, and reporting style.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert data into insights and strategic action.
* Excellent spoken & written client-friendly communication.
* Experience with US clients and international markets.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
* Bonus: Good copywriting instincts, CRO/landing page understanding, or funnel experience.

**Required Skills**

* PPC (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
* Project management
* Client communication and escalation handling
* Analytics and reporting (including GA4, Looker Studio)
* White-label agency coordination

**Preferred Skills**

* Good copywriting instincts
* CRO/landing page understanding
* Funnel experience

**Job Description:**

**Department:**

**Job Title:**
Assistant General Manager - CRM

  **customer acquisition and upgrades**

  **premium-product revenue mix**

  through SAP and Salesforce, and the development of a robust CRM organization. The role must provide clear commercial direction, review performance at defined intervals, remove execution bottlenecks and ensure that business commitments are delivered through disciplined cross-functional coordination.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

**International Business Strategy and Revenue Delivery**

* Translate the approved annual international distribution strategy into market-wise, quarter-wise and customer-wise execution plans.
* Own the achievement of the approved export distribution sales invoicing target and review progress against quarterly milestones.
* Drive year-on-year growth through existing-customer expansion, new customer acquisition, customer upgrades and improved premium-product penetration.
* Review the performance of assigned regions, distribution partners, direct offices and customer segments, and implement corrective actions for target gaps.
* Lead preparation for the annual business plan and budget process and ensure that the operating plan is supported by realistic forecasts, customer actions and collection plans.

**Business Development and Customer Growth**

* Engage existing and potential international customers for business development and relationship expansion.
* Establish customer-segmentation priorities and ensure structured engagement with A and B customers, along with periodic follow-up for C and D customers.
* Drive business from new and upgraded customers in line with the approved annual and quarterly contribution targets.
* Review regional opportunities, market constraints, forecast-versus-actual gaps and customer-specific actions with regional stakeholders.

**CRM and Customer-Service Governance**

* Ensure a high and consistent level of service to existing and potential customers throughout the enquiry-to-order, order-to-shipment and post-shipment lifecycle.
* Lead CRM governance across assigned markets, including customer master data, follow-up trackers, customer health reports, customer feedback, open-point closure and service escalations.
* Ensure timely customer communication on order status, documentation, payments, shipment schedules, complaints, returns and regulatory requirements.
* Review customer follow-up presentations, customer-focused inputs, collected 4Q feedback and customer action plans before management reviews.
* Ensure that the CRM team maintains complete, accurate and current records in Salesforce, SAP and approved trackers.

**Sales Forecasting, Invoice Planning and Performance Reviews**

* Govern the 12-week rolling forecast process and ensure that forecast inputs are collected, validated, consolidated and reviewed at the prescribed frequency.
* Review the monthly invoice plan, expected sales and collection position, order pipeline, dispatch readiness and forecast-versus-actual challenges.
* Review sales, order, invoice and collection dashboards and ensure that data is available for global sales and collection performance meetings.
* Ensure periodic review of order-to-shipment reports, customer health reports, pending sales orders and key operational trackers.

**Order-to-Cash, DSO and Collection Control**

* Own DSO performance for the assigned international distribution business and drive progressive achievement of the approved quarterly DSO milestones.
* Review customer ledgers, overdue and due receivables, collection plans, credit risks and shipment holds with the CRM team.
* Ensure that monthly collection plans are prepared, communicated and actively followed up with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure that proforma invoices, sales contracts and orders are processed within the approved turnaround time, subject to receipt of advance payment where applicable.
* Ensure that orders are correctly created, verified, approved and released in SAP and that OBD, invoicing and shipment activities are completed within defined service levels.
* Escalate material payment, credit, documentation or shipment risks early and ensure closure through cross-functional coordination.

**Distributor Agreements and Commercial Documentation**

* Oversee preparation, validation, issuance and execution of distributor agreements for assigned markets.
* Ensure that agreement data is correctly uploaded and maintained in SAP and Salesforce.
* Oversee preparation and customer acceptance of sales contracts, pro forma invoices and related commercial documents for each order.
* Drive implementation and adoption of the Agreement Module in Salesforce in accordance with the approved project plan and go-live milestone.
* Ensure document completeness, version control, approval compliance and accessibility for audit and operational use.

**Logistics, Shipment and Inventory Coordination**

* Review order and logistics efficiency, pending dispatches, shipment risks and order-to-shipment performance with CRM and logistics stakeholders.
* Support the transition and review of FOB-to-CIF processes and ensure that nominated-agent details are made available for FOB shipments where required.
* Review non-moving stock and ensure that market, customer and shipment actions are defined and tracked to reduce inventory risk.
* Ensure timely resolution of documentation, payment, regulatory and logistics issues that may delay shipment.
* Govern implementation of the Salesforce Freight Portal and ensure process adoption after go-live.

**Regulatory, Quality, PMS and Returns Coordination**

* Ensure that product registration information and certificates received from customers or regional teams are shared with the Regulatory function in a timely manner.
* Ensure follow-up on product registration trackers with the Regulatory team for assigned markets.
* Ensure collection and tracking of customer-wise and product-wise post-market-surveillance feedback in line with defined requirements.
* Ensure that customer complaints are supported by complete complaint forms and routed through the approved quality-management process, including Track Wise/DMS activities.
* Ensure that goods-return details are correctly processed in SAP after confirmation from the relevant stores or operations team.
* Support applicable MDR and compliance audits and ensure timely closure of assigned observations.

**Systems, Digital Transformation and Process Improvement**

* Drive SAP-Salesforce automation, Salesforce master-data quality, process controls and management dashboards, including Power BI or other approved tools.
* Lead the Agreement Module and Freight Portal projects in Salesforce from project initiation through go-live and stabilization.
* Support development and adoption of online PMS feedback tools and other approved CRM/process solutions.
* Review process performance, identify control gaps, standardize workflows and sponsor continuous-improvement initiatives through the Menlo Park/Kaizen mechanism.

**Management Reporting, Meetings and Compliance**

* Prepare and present accurate information for management reviews, global sales and collection performance meetings, customer-focused meetings and business-plan discussions.
* Ensure that dashboards, trackers and review packs clearly show target achievement, DSO, collections, forecasts, customer actions, premium-product mix, new/upgrade business and project status.

**Functional Skills Required:**

* International distribution sales strategy and business development
* CRM governance, customer lifecycle management and service escalation
* Sales forecasting, gap analysis, pipeline and performance dashboards
* DSO, receivables, collection planning and credit-risk management
* Order-to-cash process, SAP order release, OBD, invoicing and shipment coordination
* Distributor agreements, sales contracts and proforma-invoice governance
* SAP and Salesforce implementation, automation and master-data control
* Management reporting, Power BI/analytics and executive presentations
* Regulatory registration, PMS feedback, complaint and returns coordination
* Process improvement, SOP governance, audits, budgeting and project management
* Team structure design, performance management, coaching and capability building

**Behavioural Skills Required:**

* Customer orientation and service ownership
* Commercial drive, aggressiveness and will to win
* Innovation, adaptability and change leadership
* Entrepreneurial thinking and opportunity orientation
* Passion, commitment and personal accountability
* Analytical thinking and evidence-based decision-making
* Clear communication, influencing and cross-cultural stakeholder management
* Respectful people leadership, coaching, collaboration, high process discipline, integrity, effective prioritization and timely action closure

**Team Size to be Handled:**

* Role involves managing a team of 2 members.

**Specific Professional Competencies:**

title: Chief Growth Officer
description:
**Chief Growth Officer, VERDICT** 




  





**SVECTOR** 
 · Full\-time · Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (On\-site)
 



  





**About the role** 




 VERDICT is SVECTOR's product for talent decisions: leadership hiring, enterprise assessment, and volume hiring. Right now it runs on founder conviction. This role exists to test that conviction against real buyers and turn it into a business that doesn't need the founder to close every deal.
 



  





**The mandate** 




 Convert founder belief into tested market evidence: who pays, why, how much, how urgently. Then build the pricing, positioning, and playbook that make VERDICT repeatable, not one relationship's worth of revenue.
 



  





 This is not a Head of Sales role. If it were about meetings booked and calls made, it would carry that title. This role is accountable for whether VERDICT becomes a business.
 



  





**What you'll own** 




 Not sales alone. The whole commercial system: acquisition, pricing, positioning, retention, expansion, and deal design.
 



  




* Run early discovery personally, before there's a finished product or case study to lean on
* Personally close the first customers, then document what worked so it can be taught
* Decide when founder involvement changes the odds of closing, and use that leverage sparingly
* Forecast honestly: what's likely, what's possible, what isn't happening without a specific change
* Negotiate for value, not just price: trade concessions for term length, references, or faster payment
* Understand VERDICT well enough to sell it without a script and to push back on product or pricing with market evidence



  





**Who actually fits this** 




 We're not looking for activity. We're looking for someone who gets real energy from building something out of nothing, and who can prove they've closed before, not just supported the process.
 



  




* You've personally originated and closed enterprise deals, and carried a number you were directly accountable for
* You've negotiated pricing and terms with senior buyers, not just relayed a quote
* You've navigated procurement, legal, or multi\-stakeholder buying and gotten the deal signed anyway
* You'd rather prove one repeatable motion than chase five directions at once
* You write clearly enough to move a deal forward by email and proposal, not calls alone



  





**This won't work if** 



* You measure your own success by meetings booked or pipeline size rather than closed, quality revenue
* You need a finished product, complete pricing, and a lead list before you can sell
* You'd route every deal through the founder rather than owning it
* You're looking for a big team or title on day one. Both are earned here, not granted upfront



  





**Location and terms** 




 Ahmedabad, full\-time, on\-site, with regular travel to customer and strategic\-account locations. Compensation combines a fixed component with variable pay tied to commercial outcomes. Structure and any long\-term value participation are set out in the offer based on experience and demonstrated capability.
 



  





**How we'll evaluate you** 




 A first screening round, followed by a conversation with the hiring lead, a written case assessment, and a final conversation with our Founder\-CEO, SDS.

 We are looking for a senior
 **Apparel / Category Leader** 
 who can own the Baby \& Kids Wear business end\-to\-end from
 **category strategy, consumer and trend understanding, design and product development to sourcing, merchandising, inventory planning, launches and commercial performance** 
 .
 



  





 This is a business ownership role, not a pure design or merchandising position.
 



 You will be responsible for building commercially successful collections while ensuring the right balance between
 **design, quality, price, availability, inventory and profitability** 
 .
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong understanding of the
 **complete apparel value chain** 
 and experience scaling Baby Wear, Kids Wear or related fashion/apparel categories across retail, D2C or other consumer businesses.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Category \& Business Ownership
 


* Own the
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 and its overall business performance.
* Develop annual, seasonal and category growth plans.
* Own category\-level revenue, margin, profitability and inventory outcomes.
* Analyse sales, margins, sell\-through, stock cover, ageing and SKU\-level performance.
* Identify category gaps and opportunities across price points, age groups, styles and product segments.
* Build a balanced portfolio of core, seasonal and new products.
* Drive sustainable category growth while maintaining healthy inventory and margins.



 Design \& Collection Development
 


* Lead the development of seasonal and core collections from concept to launch.
* Define collection themes, colour palettes, prints, fabrics, silhouettes and product direction.
* Translate consumer insights, market trends and competitive intelligence into commercially viable products.
* Build and manage collection calendars and launch timelines.
* Ensure collections have the right balance of
 **fashion, functionality, comfort, safety and commercial viability** 
 .
* Evaluate product performance and use consumer and sales data to inform future collections.



 Product Development \& Apparel Expertise
 


* Own product development from initial concept through sampling, approvals and production.
* Have strong knowledge of
 **knitted and woven fabrics** 
 and their application in baby and kids apparel.
* Understand GSM, shrinkage, pilling, colourfastness, fabric performance and garment durability.
* Have strong understanding of fit, patterns, stitching, trims, construction and garment finishing.
* Ensure apparel meets appropriate standards for
 **comfort, quality, durability and safety** 
 for babies and children.
* Work closely with technical and quality teams to resolve product and manufacturing issues.



 Sourcing \& Vendor Management
 


* Build and manage a reliable network of
 **mills, garment manufacturers, factories and trim suppliers** 
 .
* Drive product development and sourcing from concept to commercial production.
* Evaluate and develop vendors based on quality, capability, capacity, cost and delivery performance.
* Own product costing, BOMs, target pricing and manufacturing feasibility.
* Negotiate with suppliers to achieve competitive cost structures without compromising quality.
* Monitor vendor performance and drive improvements in quality, lead time and OTIF.
* Develop alternate sourcing options for critical products and materials.



 Merchandising \& Range Management
 


* Lead merchandising strategy across the Baby \& Kids Wear portfolio.
* Build assortment plans based on consumer demand, seasonality, price points and channel requirements.
* Define SKU architecture and collection depth.
* Monitor product\-level performance and make timely decisions on replenishment, markdowns, continuation and discontinuation.
* Ensure new collections are launched with the right inventory and channel readiness.



 Forecasting \& Inventory Planning
 


* Own demand forecasting and seasonal merchandise planning.
* Work closely with sales and ecommerce teams to translate demand signals into inventory requirements.
* Establish SKU\-level inventory plans and replenishment mechanisms.
* Maintain healthy stock cover and inventory turns.
* Minimise stock\-outs, excess inventory and ageing stock.
* Use sales and inventory data to continuously improve forecast accuracy and buying decisions.



 Team Leadership
 


* Lead and develop teams across
 **design, merchandising and product development** 
 .
* Set clear KRAs, KPIs, SOPs and review mechanisms.
* Build a strong product and category culture focused on ownership and commercial outcomes.
* Mentor team members and build leadership capability within the function.
* Ensure clear accountability across the product lifecycle.



 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Supply Chain
* Procurement
* Quality
* Ecommerce
* Retail / Sales
* Marketing
* Finance
* Operations



 to ensure seamless execution from
 **product concept → development → sourcing → production → launch → sell\-through** 
 .
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* Category Revenue \& Growth
* Gross Margin \& Profitability
* Collection Launch Adherence
* Product Success Rate
* Sell\-through %
* Inventory Turns
* Stock Cover
* Forecast Accuracy
* Stock\-out \& Ageing Inventory
* Vendor OTIF
* Product Quality \& Returns
* New Product Contribution
* Team Performance



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **10\+ years of experience** 
 in apparel, fashion, merchandising, category management or product leadership.
* Strong experience in
 **Baby Wear / Kids Wear / Children's Apparel** 
 is highly preferred.
* Experience owning or significantly contributing to a complete apparel category or business.
* Strong understanding of the
 **end\-to\-end apparel value chain** 
 — design, product development, fabrics, sourcing, manufacturing, merchandising and inventory.
* Strong fabric and garment knowledge, particularly across knitted and woven products.
* Proven experience in vendor development, product costing and manufacturing management.
* Strong understanding of demand forecasting, assortment planning and inventory management.
* Commercial orientation with the ability to connect product decisions to
 **revenue, margin and profitability** 
 .
* Experience working with retail, D2C, ecommerce or consumer brands.
* Strong team leadership and cross\-functional stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high ownership and accountability.



  





**Qualification** 




 Graduate / Postgraduate in
 **Fashion Design, Textile Technology, Apparel Manufacturing, Fashion Management** 
 or a related discipline.
 



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for candidates currently working in senior roles such as
 **Apparel Head, Category Head, Business Head, Product Head, Design \& Merchandising Head or similar leadership positions** 
 within Baby Wear, Kids Wear, Fashion, Apparel, Retail, D2C or consumer brands.
 



 The ideal candidate should have demonstrated ownership across multiple stages of the apparel value chain and be able to combine
 **strong product understanding with commercial and category thinking** 
 .
 



  





 Why Join?
 


* Lead and build a high\-potential
 **Baby \& Kids Wear category** 
 .
